description.narrative:
Joint project with UNDP and Brookings Institution with the main objecitve to bring gender equality into the core of the conversations around public finance during the preparation process for and the outcome document of the Financing for Development Forum (FfDF) that will take place in Seville, Spain, from 30 June to 3 July 2025.The project will include the following activities:
• Convene three roundtables in key moments before the FfD. Specific activities include convening and organizing the roundtables and co-leading with Brookings on preparation of the agenda, dialog and roundtables. Brookings will lead on preparation of the Concept Notes and discussion questions, as well as post-event summaries. The two institutions will jointly identify speakers and participants for each event. • Bilateral consultations between February and May 2025 with member states to advocate for gender equality and identify opportunities and bottlenecks (particularly those who attended the Global Dialogue in Istanbul) and recommendations that will be used to design support to countries. • Post-FFD Summit: Development of an “Operational Framework” to help implement the provisions in the FFD agreements that accelerate progress toward gender equality; and validate the Operational Framework through a small convening with key government stakeholders. • Contribute to the elements paper and embed gender equality into broader discussions including those hosted by UNDP, such as the Global Dialogue on Public Finance and SDGs of January 2025.
Specifically Brookings institutions contribution is to provide: • Thought leadership contributions to expert group meetings, as described above, including preparing pre-meeting background notes, agendas and discussion questions, post-event summaries and blog. Dissemination through Brookings channels and participation in related events occurring over the course of 2024-25.
